minutes_text:
OLD TOWN LA VERNE BUSINESS IMPROVEMENT DISTIRICT
  MINUTES OF THE SPECIAL MEETING
  Tuesday, October 29, 2024

1.  WELCOME AND CALL TO ORDER

  Chairperson Walters called the meeting to order at 8:35 a.m. The following Board
  Members were present: Craig Walters, Micky Rehm, Zuhey Espinoza, and George
  Henderson. Board Members absent: Marianne Stark. City Representatives present:
  Community Development Director Eric Scherer, City Manager Ken Domer, Mayor Tim
  Hepburn, Councilman Steve Johnson, and Secretary Natalie Hiatt. Others present:
  Nathan Ulsh, Carly Adams, Cindy Feng, Maria Faura and Luis Faura.

2,  CALENDAR
  Halloween Trick or Treat  Thursday, October 3l't 2-5pm
  Cruisin La Verne Car Show  Saturday, November 23'd 10am-
  4pm
  Holiday Stroll  Saturday, December 7th 3pm

3.  APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES

  None

4.  NEW BUSINESS

  A.  Introduction of Community Strategies for Evaluation and Action Plan -Nathan
  Ulsh of Community Strong Strategies was present at the meeting and his
  colleagues Carly Adams and Cindy Feng joined viaZoom. The Board discussed
  their vision of Old Town and the areas in need of improvement.

  Mayor Hepburn stated the importance of Old Town becoming a destination with
  the redevelopment, retail, and Gold Line.

  Mr. Ulsh and his team will perform a four-month survey, build a strategy, and
  make recommendations. He stated that there are also grants available outside of
  the City that can be utilized.

  Mr. Ulsh will attend the BID's next regular meeting in December

5.  CONTINUED BUSINESS

  A.  Holiday Stroll Update - Ms. Rehm stated that she spoke to Community Services
  and they do not have staff available to work the event and are unable to provide
  Santa's chair. The ULV choir is also not available to perform. Ms. Rehm
  recommended the parents take their own pictures.
   Mr. Domer said that the microphone and lights will be available. Ms. Faura
  offered to provide Santa's chair.

  B.  Cancellation of November 4ft Meeting - The next regular meeting was cancelled
  and the Board will meet again on December 2nd.

6.  COMMITTEE RE,PORTS/ UPDATES

  A. City Report (Eric Scherer): None
  B. University Report (Zthey Espinoza): Dr. Espinoza stated that the University raised
  $100,000 at their golf tournament. She also announced the next Gala will be held
  May 3'2025.
  C. Marketing (Micky Rehm): None
  D. Chamber Report: None
  E. Social Media Update (Micky Rehm): None
  F. Financial Report: None
7  PUBLIC COMMENT (Any discussion or action on non-agendized items must be
  deferred to the following meeting, as required by Califomia Brown Act Law)

  None
